reports.title: PDD Holdings Announces Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results

desk.headline: Revenue flat at RMB108.3bn, below estimates; adjusted EPS of RMB21.04 per ADS beats as marketing spend falls; no guidance
results: Revenue was flat at RMB108.3bn, about 6% below the RMB115.6bn estimate.
Advertising (online marketing) revenue rose 12% to RMB59.8bn, but transaction services revenue fell 12% to RMB48.5bn.
Marketing spend dropped to RMB25.3bn from RMB30.3bn, lifting operating profit to RMB31.2bn from RMB25.0bn.
Adjusted EPS of RMB21.04 per ADS was level with a year ago but above the RMB18.84 estimate; net income was RMB29.5bn.
Operating cash flow was RMB43.0bn and cash plus short-term investments reached RMB455.4bn.

guidance.summary: PDD gives no financial guidance. Management said it remains in a strategic investment phase and that payback may take time.

points: Co-CEO Jiazhen Zhao said competition in Chinese e-commerce remains intense, with no platform pulling back.
PDD is expanding its RMB100bn merchant support programme and investing in supply chains and logistics.
Co-CEO Lei Chen said shifting trade rules and regulation complicate inventory and delivery for overseas sellers.
The finance chief warned against reading one quarter's cost ratios as a guide to future profit.
call.source: Call coverage: Benzinga via Longbridge, 19 Nov 2026; results context from Reuters via RTÉ, 19 Nov 2026

watch: Whether transaction services revenue (which includes Temu) keeps shrinking.
Marketing and merchant-support spending against profit.
Effects of overseas trade and regulatory changes on Temu.
